heat.title: Spending calendar
heat.emptyBody: No expenses were recorded, so every day is empty and there is no scale to shade by. Add an entry, or pick another month.
heat.gridCaption: Spending day by day for {month}. Each cell shows the day and what was spent on it; the shading groups the days into four bands.
heat.scaleNote: The four shades split the {days} days you spent on between {min} and {max}, into four bands of about a quarter each. The edges are where one band ends and the next begins — they move with the month, so a darker day means more than the quiet days around it, not more than last month. Amounts are in {currency}.
heat.scaleOneDay: Only one day had spending this month, so there is nothing to compare it against. The one day is shown in the top band because it is the whole month.
heat.scaleNone: Every day that had spending this month cost the same amount, so there is nothing to rank them against. The days with entries are all in the top band, because each of them is tied for the dearest day of the month.
heat.legend: The four bands, and where they begin
heat.bandEmptyRange: a day with no expenses on it
heat.panelError: That day could not be read. Close the panel and try again.
heat.panelEmpty: Nothing was spent on this day. The cell is empty because there is no entry to show, not because the day is missing.
heat.panelTruncated: Showing the {shown} newest of the {total} entries on this day. The total above covers all {total} of them.
